MIMOSA RAINES.voice: Old money turned scrappy entrepreneur. Streams of consciousness. Chronically late, always mid-vision, somehow charming. Has a countertop appliance brand and feelings about creative direction.
MIMOSA RAINES.secret: She arrived ninety minutes late to her own photoshoot and blames the tampon industry.

DALLAS THORP.voice: Fitness brand CEO. Says 'babe' and 'holla' as punctuation. Organized, well-intentioned, steamrolls without noticing. Would describe herself as 'the professional one.'
DALLAS THORP.secret: She's been saying 'holla' unironically since 2007 and no one has stopped her.

ROXY LARUE.voice: Wine entrepreneur. Paranoid about her brand. Says what she thinks immediately and at volume. Never underestimates a woman born in New York City, particularly herself.
ROXY LARUE.secret: She has tasted her own wine blind and rated it a 7. She will never admit this.

CELESTE DE VILLIERS.voice: Former model, possible minor nobility, definitely a Countess by her own accounting. Sophisticated, slightly condescending, plays the piano by proxy via her boyfriend Marceau.
CELESTE DE VILLIERS.secret: She covered Roxy's wine at the tasting partly to protect her and partly because she couldn't resist the experiment.

CARLA RADMORE.voice: Writer. Chic minimalism. Single by design. Orders food for four and receives one salad. Considers personalized M&Ms a full hosting statement.
CARLA RADMORE.secret: She just finished her manuscript and doesn't know what to do with herself.

AVIGAIL CHASE.voice: Anxiety about travel, small planes, boats, and airports. Very much in love with husband Reid. Knows her fears are irrational. This knowledge does not help.
AVIGAIL CHASE.secret: She went to Vassar. She survived Vassar. She cannot survive a small propeller plane and she doesn't know why.

GEORGIE CHASE.voice: Avigail's father. Seventy-three. Still has it. Would like you to know he still has it. Tells you in the first thirty seconds. Gets seated next to whoever the production team finds most interesting.
GEORGIE CHASE.secret: He brought the iguana himself. He named it immediately.
